entries.a5b67a775834a1c1: It is promoting the medium-term management plan "DK-One Next," which covers the ten years from the fiscal year ended March 2023 to the fiscal year ending March 2032. While securing growth funds from its main automotive exhaust gas purification catalyst materials, it is focusing management resources on the strategic fields of semiconductors and electronics, energy and healthcare, and strengthening its structure through six pillars: "creating new businesses," "reforming the profit structure," "realizing innovative manufacturing," "practicing an organization that continues to produce results," "further fostering the KIGENSO character," and "efforts toward sustainability." From the medium-term period starting with the fiscal year ending March 2027, growing sales in the strategic fields is its most important task, and it positions the expansion and stable operation of its Vietnamese subsidiary factory, which began full operation in July 2025, as the foundation for growth.
